CLINICAL FEATURES OF PANIC DISORDER
Clinical Features
A feeling of choking, pounding heart, chest pressure or pain, dizziness,
shortness of breath, trembling, sweating, tingling or numbness in the hands or
feet, hot flushes
Differential Diagnoses
- Other causes of intense fear (phobias, obsessive-compulsive disorders,
etc.)
- Medical causes (e.g. hyperthyroid states, episodic hypoglycaemia, etc.)
- Seizure disorders
